body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant mode = sanctioned exception); outermost ring always AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Below view PLUMB, dim 0.06. Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never `def.graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline (deferred switches, snapshot rows, measured heights, gutter).
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank only; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: summary bits pre-gate, REAL virtual probe required before any migration stairs job (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine**: intercept third-party jobs with targetA.Map != pawn.Map -> route or NoJob.
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair/ladder/elevator art; risers on host atlases. Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only.
- **PARITY AUDIT IS THE ROADMAP**: docs/CrossLevelParityAudit.md, updated as gaps close.

## BATCH BUILD (2026-07-23, "build all batches") — ALL P1+P2 BUILT, compile green, in-game verification pending
- **Trade beacons column-wide** (TradeAcrossLevels.cs): AllLaunchableThingsForTrade postfix appends linked levels' beacon goods (static `appending` reentrancy guard; inner enumeration exception-shielded); LaunchThingsOfType prefix fulfills debt across the column (vanilla per-map beacon loop replicated minus early error; single error only when whole column short). Caravan physical trading + pawn selling stay per-level BY DESIGN.
- **Refuel/vat demand** (CrossLevelDemand.AddRefuelNeeds, `supplyFuel` toggle + checkbox/scribe/reset/keyed): auto-refuel comps register shortfall to TargetFuelLevel, alternatives aggregated (40 refuelables/map cap). Covers turrets + growth vats.
- **Transporter loading** (AddTransporterNeeds): leftToLoad manifests register shortfall; local load giver finishes.
- **Surgery ingredients** (AddSurgeryNeeds, under supplyBills): bills on PAWN BillStacks (health.surgeryBills) — medicine/hemogen/body parts flow to the patient's level. Ingredient block refactored into shared AddRecipeIngredientNeeds.
- **Baby food** (AddMealNeeds extension): Biotech babies register a 2/baby buffer (BabyFood def, silent-fail).
- **Mech recharge routing** (MechChargeAcrossLevels.cs): JobGiver_GetEnergy_Charger postfix — ShouldAutoRecharge via reflection (0.35 pct fallback), charger usability via CanPawnChargeCurrently under VIRTUAL SWAP, stairs toward charger, 600t cooldown. crossLevelNeeds gate.
- **Gear probes** (GearAcrossLevels.cs): shared ABGearAcrossLevels.TryRoute — virtual swap at exit + re-run the SAME vanilla giver (reflection, instances cached), discard probe job, stairs with Reroute to found thing; shared 2000t per-pawn cooldown; VirtualScanActive doubles as recursion guard for the patched givers. Three flavors: JobGiver_OptimizeApparel (tick-window opened for probe, reset on route so arrival re-scans), JobGiver_PickUpOpportunisticWeapon (unarmed only), JobGiver_MoveDrugsToInventory.
- **Gatherings** (GatheringsAcrossLevels.cs): ThinkNode_JoinVoluntarilyJoinableLord postfix — joinable non-ritual lords (parties/marriages/speeches) with VoluntaryJoinPriorityFor > 0 on linked levels pull attendees (rituals excluded — own module). crossLevelRituals gate, 600t cooldown.
- **Detectors** (LevelWorkSummary): construction += BuildRoof/NoRoof areas; NEW wtChildcare (babies present) + wtMechRepair (RepairMech giver's workType resolved at runtime; damaged player mechs) — both null-safe without Biotech.
- **P3 stays excluded by design**: Anomaly containment, anima travel, turret gap targeting (each needs a dedicated design pass; turrets conflict with the manual-combat rule).

## SAME-DAY PRIOR (2026-07-23, all compile green, verification rolling)
- Install/uninstall parity: "Bring {mini} and install it here" + automatic mini ferry (also in robot enumerators).
- Robot bounce fix: probe-gated migration via CrossLevelWork.ProbeWorkAt (robot's own giver list). Run #70 dock-loop fix (both patch shapes + cross-map intercept). Fence patch revived.
- Container-storage push fix: TryFindBestBetterStorageFor (graves/caskets/Deep-Storage-style destinations).
- Verify sweep: research/fire/hunting confirmed covered.
- Achtung drags; meditation redirect; construction supply giver; "Bring and build" order; jobs settings tab (presets/sliders/flow checkboxes + supplyFuel NEW); biome-driven plateaus; climb animations + wide stairs; art tuner.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work both directions; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers (DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE); work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; jobs tab now has 5 flow checkboxes (construction/bills/meals/fuel/fetch) + presets + cadence sliders (all consts live).

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; cap corner fillers; DEV: Adjust art (bake fold-in pending).

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots (verified) + Robots++ (probe-gated, unverified). Achtung! drags (soft, unverified). Container storage destinations (unverified). Modded-biome plateaus (unverified in modded biome). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: FULL P1+P2 parity batch BUILT (trade/fuel/transporters/surgery/babyfood/mech-charge/gear-probes/gatherings/roof-areas/childcare/mech-repair) on top of the morning's fixes — everything compile green, one combined in-game verification pass needed (suggest companions: Misc Robots + Robots++ [+ Achtung]; Biotech items need mechs/babies). Audit updated (P1/P2 struck, P3 documented exclusions). Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
